# Noto Sans Arabic

Static Light (300) and Regular (400) TrueType fonts, unmodified from `full/ttf/`
in the official Noto Sans Arabic **2.013** release:

https://github.com/notofonts/arabic/releases/tag/NotoSansArabic-v2.013

Archive: https://github.com/notofonts/arabic/releases/download/NotoSansArabic-v2.013/NotoSansArabic-v2.013.zip

Archive SHA-256: `1301aceaea84c501cf2e6dcfb3182e2328c8eae5725817fcb239672bda7154f1`.

Font SHA-256 values:

```
fdad48f549b7d44e2926d0f19d300a221ae0a480d40e57b394df7359d2f6cf59  NotoSansArabic-Light.ttf
7ed3fe069312aceac454f17cf613a30f95271d6ed7ce58005ed4d016bd3823d7  NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf
```

These full fonts include Latin characters for mixed Arabic/Latin labels and are
embedded locally in the launcher and standalone controller page as an offline
fallback. The interfaces prefer the PS4's installed SST Arabic when available;
the page requests it from the local PS4, without an internet font service.
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1,
retained in `OFL.txt`.
